notes: Conditional Access Vault is now a single product with every feature included — backups, restore, continuous drift detection, auto-restore, investigation timeline, and 1-year audit retention. The old Standard / Pro / Premium tiers are gone; the purchase page and per-tenant assignment now show one Conditional Access Vault that's either active or not.
Bundle naming uses the full 'Conditional Access Vault' everywhere instead of the 'CAV' shorthand, and the per-tenant assignment row shows a clean 'Active' state instead of a tier badge.
